items.h: This talk in Chennai will explore the Great Nicobar project and its environmental costs
items.snip: Writer Pankaj Sekhsaria will discuss the Great Nicobar project, its environmental costs and his new book, Island on Edge: The Great Nicobar Crisis with Frontline’s Vaishna Roy

items.h: Vizianagaram Mayor poll moved to October 29 over Sirimanotsavam; counting stays on October 30
items.snip: The State Election Commission accepts the district administration’s request to shift polling by a day

items.h: Sabarimala pilgrimage: KSRTC to deploy over 1,000 buses
items.snip: A total of 461 buses will be arranged for Mandala pooja and 561 for Makaravilakku, in addition to leased vehicles. Special services will run from major depots across the State to key hubs like Pampa and Nilakkal, and chartered trips will be arranged through the Budget Tourism Cell.

items.h: HR Manager cannot be prosecuted for abetment to suicide over denying leave or marking employee absent: Madras High Court
items.snip: Justice G.K. Ilanthiraiyan relies upon a Supreme Court dictum that, in such cases, mens rea could not be gleaned merely by what goes on in the mind of the victim

items.h: Modi government has no moral right to remain in power: Congress flags ‘lapses’ in PM-DAKSH scheme
items.snip: Jairam Ramesh alleged “serious lapses” in the PM-DAKSH skill training scheme for Scheduled Castes, OBCs and other marginalised groups, saying its budget has gone largely unutilised for two years

items.h: T.N. Minister reviews Northeast monsoon preparedness in Cuddalore
items.snip: Of the total 239 vulnerable locations identified across Cuddalore district, 22 have been classified as very highly vulnerable. Officials have readied 28 cyclone shelters, 14 multipurpose shelters and 191 temporary shelters.

items.h: Kochi’s waste management facilities under scanner after Perumbavoor yard fire
items.snip: There are around 15 non-biodegradable waste management companies empanelled by the Suchitwa Mission, including the one which was gutted in fire, while several unauthorised firms also operate in the secto

items.h: NHAI turns to AI and open source to preserve institutional knowledge lost to officer transfers
items.snip: The highway authority’s internal AI assistant helps officials navigate policies, contracts and project reports, while its developers work to make employees’ expertise reusable across offices

items.h: After Amazon, Google targets Nvidia’s software lock-in with TorchTPU
items.snip: TorchTPU lets developers run PyTorch workloads on Google’s AI chips with minimal code changes, as cloud providers seek to make their in-house accelerators easier to use

items.h: Supreme Court defers AP municipal poll final list to October 25 on YSRCP plea, directs SEC to decide on nominations
items.snip: The court holds that the YSRCP has made out a prima facie case in its plea for more time to file nominations

items.h: CMRL-Exalogic payoff case: Supreme Court stays probe on corruption FIR against former CM Pinarayi Vijayan
items.snip: ‘We will not disturb the FIR, but we will stall the investigation. Further, we are sending this case back to the High Court for adjudication,’ the Bench said

items.h: Four Indian Rollers, Telangana’s State bird, rescued during Dasara celebrations in Hyderabad
items.snip: People can report illegal confinement or mistreatment of wildlife by dialing toll-free numbers 18004255364 and 9803338666, or emergency response number 112

items.h: The whales never stopped coming to Gujarat’s beaches, the watchers did
items.snip: Every cetacean in India is protected under Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act 1972, which is the same level of protection accorded to tigers and lions. Yet most of us may not recognise a Bryde’s whale on the beach, may not know whom to call, and may never think to ask what happened to it afterwards

items.h: Children in Kochi begin formal learning on Vijayadashami as CM Satheesan leads event
items.snip: Holding the hands of around 25 children at the ceremony in Kochi, the CM guided them to write ‘Harishree’ in Malayalam with their index finger on rice-filled platters

items.h: Northeast monsoon gathers momentum in Tamil Nadu; unleashes another round of downpours over Chennai
items.snip: The spell of wet weather is expected to continue till October 26, 2026 with a low pressure area forming over southwest Bay of Bengal off Tamil Nadu during early hours of October 21

items.h: First Nation community in Canada uses data centre to preserve its heritage
items.snip: Wiikwemkoong community stores Indigenous language recordings and other information locally to safeguard its cultural legacy and control its data

items.snip: It also states that materials have surfaced during the investigation disclosing that monies collected as ‘party fund’ were handed over to the Minister

items.h: Being a good doctor is risky in India
items.snip: When people cannot access adequate food, clean water, or timely healthcare, can the solution to their illness really end with a prescription?

items.h: SEBI’s SME IPO reforms offer a financing choice as rates rise
items.snip: Looser listing norms and tougher profitability tests could help established small firms tap equity at a time when the RBI is turning hawkish
